result:
The no-caps rule is live in v29.14, but the old checks that assert caps text still need retargeting, so I'm leaving this one open.

**Shipped**
- **v29.11 (cw-nocaps-net).** The game already sends every canvas text draw, text measure and menu text node through one function, `TX`. I added a case fix there, `ncFix`, so no per-string edits were needed.
  - A word of 3+ capitals that isn't an acronym becomes lower case, keeping the first capital at the start of a line or after a full stop or a dot. "MACHINE ALERT" now draws as "Machine alert".
  - SP, XP, HP, LMG, SMG, DMR, KIA, HUD, FPS, 2P, KB+M and the like are kept. Key names become Esc, Tab, Ctrl and so on.
  - I also removed the CSS `text-transform:uppercase` everywhere. The tab title is now "Pillagers".
  - Its check records a raid frame and scans all menu text for capitals. The same check failed on the old build and passes on the new one.
- **v29.14 (cw-nocaps-dom).** Text outside `#root` is now fixed too, such as the attract card, the REC mark and the fps box. Tooltips, placeholders and aria labels are fixed as well.
  - I wrote the Taken stamp, the "Need $… more" chips and the Player 2 tab title in sentence case in the source.
- **Old check retargeted.** Check 28.91 now matches "Pre-raid" regardless of case, committed as 37caa926.

**What remains**
- **Old caps checks.** Many old checks in `tools/mkfixture.ps1` match caps text with `/PRESS ANY KEY/.test(...)`. They will fail now that menu and canvas text is lowercased. The gate only reruns the newest 80 checks, so these will show up in the nightly corpus for v29.14. They need retargeting with `fixq.sh`. I listed the likely lines in my notes at `tools/handoff/console/notes/00-no-all-caps.md`, but I haven't verified them.
- **Optional polish.** Names that were forced to caps in the source now show as "Scav pistol" rather than "Scav Pistol". Removing the `.toUpperCase()` calls would fix that.
- **Whole-game scan.** I found nothing outside the one text function. The only gap I can't rule out is text baked into image assets.

TASK PARTIAL: retarget the old caps-asserting checks that fail in the v29.14 nightly corpus, then run a final whole-game scan.
